question: What change in intercalation energy does the DFT give and at what in-plane strain, what potential change was measured and at what in-plane prestrain, and what is the ratio of computed to measured change?

rendered: The DFT simulation gives a change in intercalation energy of ∼75 meV[1] for an applied in-plane strain of +1.5%[2] on the V2O5 lattice (Fig. 4[3]). The measured change in electrochemical potential was ∼40 mV[4] at an in-plane prestrain of ∼1.66%[5] (Fig. 3[6]). The ratio of computed to measured change is 1.88[7].
